scope: One serial seven-case batch, one model load; exact P4 fixtures/seeds/caps; one changed projection-group precision policy.

point_scenario.assumption: P5 completes the same 4468 output tokens as P4 and has identical load and compute cost. This is a baseline scenario, not an expected measured result.

assumptions: P5 uses P4 load/prefill costs and the slowest observed P4 per-token decode cost.
Does not model P5 BF16/HiFi4 compute or weight-load delta; this is not an upper bound.

uncertainty: P5 has no matched load or decode measurement; BF16 weights and HiFi4 down projection can change model-load and compute time.
P5 may stop at different output lengths from P4 under the changed precision policy; exact fixture, seed and cap do not fix generated length.
The point scenario copies P4 measured wall only as a comparison baseline; do not treat it as a calibrated forecast or admission ceiling.
The cap-fill scenario is a same-P4-throughput stress case only, not an upper bound for P5.
status_note: Numerical scenarios expose output, compute, and load uncertainty; root must decide whether this is useful within the remaining stage budget.
